g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
SS 316 bar (ASTM A276), annealed shaft; flight 316 formed
Product contact: ID Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin] (A270 S2 tube); welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
P1-215 formed; ends tapered over 1/4 turn, ground

svg.text: P1-212-201 SHAFT DRIVE END (2:1): SOCKET + SLOT
P1-212-202 ALTERNATE: SECTIONAL FLIGHT BLANK (1:1), 20 per screw
Helix length outer / inner per turn
Ri = w·Li/(Lo-Li), w = 15.5; stretch on a 56-pitch jig
1. Order the flight from P1-215 with ID 25.5 to slide on; fix the start 5 from the socket end, stretch to 56 pitch, tack every 1/2 turn, then weld W7
continuous both sides (GTAW ER316LSi, 2 fillet), grind smooth, no crevices.
2. Straighten after welding: shaft TIR ≤ 0.3 [.012] and flight OD TIR ≤ 0.5 [.02] between centres B and spigot. Then turn the spigot Ø20 f7 to finish.
3. Polish flight faces and shaft to Ra ≤ 0.8 µm; passivate; check the screw slides through the barrel by hand along its full length before fitting.
4. Sectional blanks (DXF) are an alternate to the formed flight only: butt-weld 20 blanks, full penetration, ground both sides.
